name: Wolfram Language
typeSystem: Dynamic, symbolic: every piece of code and data (numbers, strings, functions, unevaluated expressions) is represented uniformly as a symbolic expression, and evaluation proceeds by repeatedly applying term-rewriting rules until a fixed point is reached.
runtime: Expressions are evaluated by the Wolfram Kernel, which repeatedly pattern-matches an expression tree against built-in and user-defined transformation rules and rewrites it until no further rule applies.

runtimes.name: Wolfram Kernel
runtimes.role: Evaluates expressions via term rewriting: it repeatedly matches patterns against rules and rewrites the expression until it stabilises.

compilers.name: Wolfram Kernel (Compile[])
compilers.role: The reference evaluator; its Compile[] function additionally compiles numerical code paths for speed.

concurrencyModel: Explicit parallel primitives (ParallelMap, ParallelTable, Parallelize) distribute evaluation across local kernels or a cluster; ordinary evaluation is otherwise single-threaded per kernel.
